houses.use: Owner quality reference: seed variation in a coherent block; pads, roads, soft daylight.

warno.use: Strong silhouettes, low-frequency colour zones, restrained subpixel detail.

cc0.use: Local ambientCG PaintedMetal002, Metal052C, CorrugatedSteel006A; CC0 by owner source ruling; no downloads.

scale.basis: Design calibration: hangar 47.75 x 48 x 19.48m; barracks 10.53 x 21.18 x 4.38m. Does not claim canonical BattleTech physical scale.

module_m.basis: Design grid: about 12 bays across reference width; inferred rhythm, not an individually measured donor panel.

mech_door_m.basis: Chosen to fit measured hangar envelope; 67% of stock height.

reveal_m.basis: Chosen real geometry depth, about one tenth of infantry door height.

panel_gap_m.basis: Chosen bounded detail: real recessed seams without high contrast noise.

bevel_m.basis: Chosen edge light catch; larger structural edges use 0.08m.

parapet_m.basis: Chosen layered roof edge with overhanging cap.

budgets.basis: Authoring targets, not measured engine performance. Budget enforced on exported triangles. Bakes 1024, LOD1 512.
